uzo.purpose: Shows a known value within a known range, with its number: 66 % conform, 3 of 5 checked.

instead.kialo: Progress of a running task moves by itself and ends, because it is a wait, not a measure; that is an Ero of its own, a person decides.
A state in a word is a badge, because a word has no scale; a meter shows where a number lies.

boundary.kialo: A chart compares many values over an axis, because one bar is one value; charts are no Ero of Fundamento.
Several parts in one bar need a legend, because colour alone names no part (WCAG 1.4.1); one meter shows one value.

containers.name: tabelo
containers.kialo: A meter in a cell shows the value of its row, because the row is what it measures.

containers.name: atributlisto
containers.kialo: A meter as a value shows the measure of the record, because the name beside it says what.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A meter stands where the number it shows is read, because the number is the content.
